digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira_family sub-seam and Jira Data Center backend
propositions: Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud share a single adapter family via explicit contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) and unified value maps rather than forked code duplicating privates from adapters/jira/.
Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) remain at their paths and are parameterized by jira_family contracts via dependency inversion, not relocated.
The DC backend rejects non-https base_url unless allow_insecure=true is set, never disables certificate verification, and requires JIRA_PAT from environment only (never from config file).

Three independent copies of the field value maps are consolidated into one definition in adapters/jira_family/, imported by both Cloud and DC backends, with the deleted->Done entry unified across all callers.

Bidirectional reconciliation against real Jira 8.17.1 Data Center is verified by live harness: inbound (issue created in DC appears locally after bootstrap-strict pass) and outbound (local edit appears on DC issue after outbound pass) must both pass with zero unhandled exceptions.

Cross-imports between adapters/jira/ and adapters/jira_datacenter/ are machine-checked and forbidden via import contract; jira_family/ may not import either backend, and both backends may import only from jira_family/.
